purpose: Classify and respond to one L1 support ticket
prerequisites: The ticket is assigned to the current agent
completionOutcome: The ticket has an approved category, SLA tier, escalation decision, grounded response draft, and audit trace

steps.title: Inspect the ticket
steps.instruction: Read only the minimum content needed and identify security, privacy, outage, and abuse signals.
steps.expectedResult: A bounded problem statement without copied secrets
steps.check: No password, token, payment-card number, or unnecessary personal data is copied
steps.escalation: Stop and notify security when credentials or active compromise are present
prohibitedActions: Paste a token into the Prompt

steps.title: Check SLA and escalation policy
steps.instruction: Use support.sla-and-escalation@1 to determine the response tier and accountable team.
steps.expectedResult: A P0, P1, or P2 decision with one allowed citation
steps.check: The selected tier and escalation match the approved Knowledge release
steps.escalation: Ask the support operations lead when the policy does not cover the case

steps.title: Render and run the approved Prompt
steps.instruction: Use the exact support.triage-customer-ticket release pinned by the Pack.
steps.expectedResult: A JSON result matching the approved output contract
steps.check: Category, SLA tier, escalation, and response are present
steps.escalation: Do not send output that fails the rubric
prohibitedActions: Silently switch to a newer release

steps.title: Verify and acknowledge
steps.instruction: Apply support.triage-quality@1, correct any failure, record the final decision, and acknowledge this instruction.
steps.expectedResult: The ticket passes the rubric and the Pack item is complete
steps.escalation: Route failed or ambiguous cases to the support operations lead
